note: Both sets cover essentially the same member sections, dimensions and the drawing scale, and both make the same doubtful claim that 9'-0" is the FIRST FLR / T.O. STEEL elevation above GRADE LEVEL, although the level markers on the sheet read GRADE LEVEL 0", FIRST FLR 2'-4", T.O. STEEL 11'-4" and 9'-0" sits in the horizontal dimension strings. Set A's extra entries are only redundant restatements of PL3"X1/4" and HSS4X4X1/4" (each given three times), whereas Set B attaches an unsupported 'conditions: S-301' to the W10X12 and HSS4X6X1/4" claims, with quotes that never mention S-301. Since B adds unsupported conditions while A only repeats correct facts, A is slightly better; both omit C8X11.5 and the overall widths 32'-0" and 27'-8".
remarks: Both sets bind 9'-0" to 'FIRST FLR T.O. STEEL elevation relative to GRADE LEVEL' by splicing non-adjacent text into the quote; the sheet's level markers give FIRST FLR 2'-4" and T.O. STEEL 11'-4", and 9'-0" appears in the base dimension strings, so this looks like a shared extraction error. Both also leave the entity for 18'-0" and 11'-4" as the vague 'elevation' instead of SOLAR ENVELOPE and T.O. STEEL, and both miss C8X11.5 plus the overall widths 32'-0" and 27'-8". Set B's 'conditions: S-301' is a sheet/detail reference, not a load or geometry condition, and is unsupported by its quotes.
